name: Caphtorim
overview: The Caphtorim are identified in Scripture as a distinct people originating from Caphtor, who played a significant role in the history of the Philistines. Genesis 10:14 links them to the Philistim, while Deuteronomy 2:23 records their conquest over the Avims, establishing themselves in their land. Jeremiah 47:4 and Amos 9:7 further affirm the Caphtorim as the ancestral source of the Philistines, emphasizing God's sovereign hand in their movements and interactions with Israel.
